query:
select
                news_push_notifications.id,
                push_notifications.sender as "sender!: DIS",
                push_notifications.title as "title!: DIS",
                push_notifications.content as "content!: DIS",
                push_notifications.send_at,
                push_notifications.sent,
                coalesce(stats.n_sent, 0) as "n_sent!",
                coalesce(stats.n_opened, 0) as "n_opened!",
                coalesce(stats.n_dismissed, 0) as "n_dismissed!"
            from news_push_notifications
            inner join news on news.id = news_push_notifications.news_id
            inner join push_notifications
                on push_notifications.id = news_push_notifications.notification_id
            left join notification_stats stats on stats.notification_id = push_notifications.id
            where news.target_group_id = $1
            order by push_notifications.send_at, news_push_notifications.id
